subject: Proposal: temporary headcount swap (Ops -> Eng) + band impact
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 26 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Proposal: temporary headcount swap (Ops -> Eng) + band impact

Team —

We have an urgent infra backlog that will materially impact Q3 product launches if we don't add at least one mid-level SWE (IC3) to the platform squad in May. Ops currently has an approved open IC3 req (Req-4789) that is live with two strong candidates from our vendor partners.

Proposal: temporarily reassign one Ops open headcount (Req-4789) to Eng for a 6-month priority assignment; Ops gets a compensating headcount credit to use in Q4. The swap would be documented in Workday and payroll would remain under Ops for the duration.

Attached is a simple model showing cost neutrality if we adjust bands for the swap and pause one Ops recruiter seat for 12 weeks. I flagged where the comp-band delta could require an uplift if we convert to permanent.

Ask: Vivek — do we have leadership sign-off to proceed with a temporary transfer for critical infra work? Marissa/Laura — can HR/payroll and finance approve the accounting treatment so we can move quickly?

Attachments: headcount_swap_model.xlsx (spreadsheet), comp_band_summary.pdf

Thanks,
Camila
Camila Reyes
Director, Talent Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 26 Apr 2027 09:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposal: temporary headcount swap (Ops -> Eng) + band impact

Camila —

Thanks for the clear proposal and the spreadsheet. High level: I support reallocating one headcount to Eng for the next 6 months provided we meet three conditions:

- No net increase in run-rate this fiscal year (finance sign-off)
- Candidate acceptance window is <30 days or we pause the offer
- Conversion path defined (if Eng wants to keep permanently, pre-approved uplift or formal req)

Marissa / Laura — please confirm the finance + HR gates. If both green, I can approve the swap and notify the execs. Noted that this is time-sensitive — infra leads said they can onboard mid-May.

Vivek
VP, Product Operations

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 26 Apr 2027 11:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Proposal: temporary headcount swap (Ops -> Eng) + band impact

Folks —

Finance is OK in principle but needs the following before we mark it approved:

1) A one-sheet that shows the marginal run-rate impact for FY27 (line-item: salary + benefits + recruiting spend). The spreadsheet Camila sent is a good start; can you add a column that isolates FY27 impact only?
2) A documented statement from Eng that this is a fixed-term assignment (6 months) with conversion process.
3) If candidate offer has a comp-band above Ops midpoint, provide the proposed uplift approach and who signs off on conversion uplift.

If we can get those by EOD Wed (28 Apr), Finance will sign off and we can instruct Talent to pause Ops recruiting and reassign the candidate pipelines.

-Marissa
Head of Finance Operations

From: Neil Carter <neil@pebbletalent.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 26 Apr 2027 14:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: candidate pool for Req-4789 (Ops)

Hi Camila —

Thanks for the heads up. We have two candidates currently in the offer conversation: Candidate A (SWE, IC3) and Candidate B (Senior Ops Analyst). Candidate A is open to Eng work and would prefer to start in mid-May; compensation expectations are listed in the spreadsheet you shared. Candidate A has another verbal from a Series B that wants an answer in 10 days.

If you decide to pursue the swap, we recommend prioritizing Candidate A and sending a tight timeline. If you pause offers, we can instruct candidates that there's a brief pause in the process.

—Neil

Date: Tue, 27 Apr 2027 08:37:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Proposal: temporary headcount swap (Ops -> Eng) + band impact

Marissa — attached is an updated one-sheet (FY27 column added) and a draft conversion statement from Eng (short term assignment with optional conversion subject to band uplift and approvals). The FY27 delta is shown as $6.2k incremental if we pay to the higher midpoint; zero if we hire at Ops midpoint.

Nikhil — can you confirm payroll/accounting treatment and whether we need a journal entry for the swap? If HR needs a formal JD change for the 6-month assignment, we'll coordinate with the Eng manager.

Camila

Attachment: headcount_swap_model.xlsx

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Proposal: temporary headcount swap (Ops -> Eng) + band impact

All —

HR and payroll confirm we can execute a temporary reallocation as a fixed-term assignment. Required next steps (HR gating items):

- Update Workday: create a temporary assignment record and attach the conversion clause (I uploaded a template to the HR drive).
- Recruiter instruction: pause any new outgoing offers for the Ops role and prioritize Candidate A if leadership instructs.
- Comp-band: if Eng signs candidate above Ops midpoint, HR requires a signed conversion approval form from Vivek and Finance prior to conversion.
- Communication to candidate: Talent team to use the exact wording in the attached candidate note template; no mention of internal swaps — treat as a re-opened Eng role for the candidate.

Provided Marissa signs finance approval (pending the FY27 one-sheet), Vivek can approve and we will execute onboarding for mid-May.

Laura Bennett
Head of People Operations
Redwood Inference
